title: Cellular engagement of the SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain by GS-441524 and enhanced in vitro inhibition by its diphosphorylated metabolite
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, Advance Article

Banhi Biswas, Junlin Zhuo, Jürgen Bosch, Hien Vu, Lorencia Pak, Rameez Raja, Anuradha Roy, Alessandro Panattoni, Michal Maryska, Petr Slavik, Kryštof Šigut, Anthony R. Fehr, Rachy Abraham, Barbara S. Slusher, Takashi Tsukamoto, Anthony K. L. Leung
GS-441524, the parent nucleoside of remdesivir, engages the SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain (Mac1) in cells, and its diphosphate metabolite exhibits enhanced inhibitory activity.
